mods.name: Wynncraft Market Price Helper
mods.description: A mod that displays the item price before Trade Market tax on Wynncraft.

releases.notes:
### Changelog
* Fixed pre-tax price showing up when finalizing a payment in the in-game store
* Removed trailing spaces at the ends of the color names in the config menu
* Improved price detection for fewer false positives
* Forced a set UTF-8 encoding for the config file to prevent file corruption
* Fixed crashing upon loading the game with missing config file elements
* Improved mod performance
  * Optimized tooltip scanning
  * Sped up font detection
  * Sped up number formatting
* Loosened dependency version requirements

### Dependencies
| Name | Version | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 | Required |
| Fabric Loader | >=0.16.0 | Required |
| Fabric API | * | Required |
| Cloth Config | >=21.0.0 | Required |
| Mod Menu | * | Optional |
